evidence_slice: Great Yarmouth Borough Council's adopted Local Plan Part 2 identifies Policy GN2, Emerald Park, Gorleston-on-Sea. Land at Emerald Park Football Ground (2.3 hectares) is allocated for approximately 100 dwellings. The council's public ArcGIS StoryMap reproduces Policy GN2 as part of the adopted Local Plan. The Part 2 Plan was adopted on 9 December 2021.
